draft.subject: Getting Quartz Ventures off the ground in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Rafael,

Following up on the mobile save button you reported -- we closed that out, so do tell me if it still isn't behaving on your end.

Since then things have been quiet, so I wanted to check in. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating a first project is usually the step that makes everything else useful. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time too.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you.

Best,
Chidi
